originStory.title: Why I Wrote This Book
originStory.subtitle: **30+ years** of lessons I wish someone had shared with me
originStory.story:
Software development has been my passion since I was **10 years old**. I've spent over **30 years** exploring, tinkering, learning, and enjoying every aspect of this craft. Throughout my career, I've seen countless talented people struggle. Not because they lacked intelligence or coding ability, but because nobody taught them how professionals actually think.

I believe first principles and concepts are at the core of building a solid practice. I consider myself a software craftsperson, and I want apprentices. I want to help people grow. I want to see the 'Aha' moment in their eyes when concepts finally click.

With AI everywhere now, understanding these fundamentals matters more than ever. I want you to thrive, fully understanding what you're doing, what AI is doing for you, and how to use both effectively. This book is my way of sharing everything I wish someone had told me when I started.
originStory.inspirationPoint: I want to see the 'Aha' moment when concepts finally click

creatorJourney.title: From Curious Kid to Software Craftsperson
creatorJourney.subtitle: **30+ years** of learning distilled into guidance for you
creatorJourney.story: My journey began at age **10** when I first discovered programming and fell in love with building things with code. In **2006**, I started my professional career and learned the hard way what separates good developers from great ones. Over the following years, I worked as developer, tech lead, solutions architect, and founded companies. I kept learning and refining my understanding of what makes software professionals truly effective.
